accepted.quote: This bill would restrict and harm the SEC's mission of investor protection and capital formation.
accepted.rationale: The quote criticizes the bill for harming the SEC's investor-protection and capital-formation mission, indicating support for strong securities regulation.

accepted.quote: The bill also dismantles, and moves the functions of, the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB) to the SEC, exposing what have traditionally been nonpartisan audit, ethics, and quality control standards to the political whims of the Commission.
accepted.rationale: The quote criticizes moving PCAOB functions to the SEC as politicizing audit standards, indicating support for independent audit oversight.
